weights: official current-wave weights normalized to equal total weight per month
inference: person-cluster CR1 with absorbed month count included in residual degrees of freedom
multiplicity: BH across the 16 primary factor/outcome joint Wald tests, separately within each period

prespecified_contrasts.education_fine: high school diploma code 2 minus bachelor code 5
prespecified_contrasts.financial_change: somewhat worse code 2 minus same code 3

sensitivity: Q8 capped at -100/+100, labelled sensitivity only; primary Q8 not trimmed
secondary: add seven individual quiz correctness variables beyond official high/low category, same complete cases
financial decision role among observed respondents, not imputed for structurally skipped cases
calendar-adjacent first differences for financial-change categories and Q8/Q9 outcomes
descriptive_distribution: monthly survey-weighted quantiles within groups, then equal-month averages; cross-person IQR and median individual density IQR reported separately
limits: Associations, not causal effects or learned behavioural weights.
Previously viewed data periods: temporal replication is not a new blinded experiment.
Current Q1 is subjective and can itself reflect inflation; reverse causality remains.
Stable entry traits cannot be identified in person fixed effects; first differences apply to changing Q1.
